svg.title: A recorded source change is not yet a corrected claim
svg.desc: A provenance hash mismatch can suppress read-time advice and identify stale context. Before commit, scoped re-scout distinguishes unchanged claims from proposed content edits. The manual route asks for re-scout, re-baseline or defer; it does not commit.
